text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: SRE-PROM-SCRAPE-TIMEOUT (severity: P2) - https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345

pagerduty-bot: escalation: page sent to on-call rotation. Policy: 2min -> 5min -> escalation.

anna-oncall: taking this. seeing a barrage of scrape timeouts from prometheus metricproxy. dashboards show a lot of series missing.

jenna-observability: confirm - grafana panels for infra:node and api:request_latency show N/A for many targets. Prometheus shows targets UP=~50%, last scrapes failing.

anna-oncall: logs from metricproxy:
```
2026-03-09T18:06:12Z WARN scrape_manager.go:786 context deadline exceeded for target https://10.32.12.7:9100/metrics
2026-03-09T18:06:13Z ERROR http_client.go:214 read tcp 10.32.11.5:50090->10.32.12.7:9100: i/o timeout
```

mike-sre: just saw PagerDuty. quick check: k8s node-exporter pods look fine, but metricproxy cpu spiking to 95% on two replicas. Could be GC/connection storms.

kai-platform: also seeing increased consumer lag on kafka topic logs-ingest-main, group=log-consumers-prod. Lag ~ 200k messages. That could explain log-driven metrics missing too (some targets push logs->metrics pipelines).

anna-oncall: customer impact? any user-facing errors?

jenna-observability: no 5xx spike in public API, but internal cost metrics and alerting relying on those prometheus series are degraded. A few internal dashboards used by partners show stale numbers. I've flagged a support ticket for exploratory customers.

mike-sre: mitigation plan proposal: 1) scale metricproxy deployment to +2 replicas, 2) temporarily increase scrape timeout from 10s -> 20s for flaky targets, 3) restart metricproxy pods one at a time, 4) kick off kafka consumer rebalance for log-consumers-prod.

anna-oncall: doing step 1 now: `kubectl -n observability scale deploy metricproxy --replicas=4`

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Command run recorded by deploy-bot.

anna-oncall: scaled. CPU dropped a bit on new replicas but still some high latencies. Running step 2: updating Prometheus config to set scrape_timeout to 20s for job=redwood/infra and job=redwood/app.

jenna-observability: patch applied, reloading prom config: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart configmap/prometheus-config` then `kubectl -n monitoring delete pod -l app=prometheus` to force reload.

mike-sre: good. while scrapes are recovering, I'll restart metricproxy pods sequentially to clear any stuck connections: `kubectl -n observability rollout restart deploy/metricproxy` (one pod terminates at a time).

[~12m later]

anna-oncall: after restart and scale, target UP is back to 92%. missing series count down from ~180 to ~12. grafana panels re-populating.

kai-platform: kafka consumer lag reduced after we bumped consumer replicas and forced a rebalance: lag -> 3k. We'll let it burn down.

mike-sre: quick root cause hypothesis: metricproxy instances were saturating sockets (ephemeral port exhaustion) under a transient spike; paired with strict 10s scrape timeout this manifested as many context deadline exceeded errors. That in turn caused downstream alerts and dashboards to show missing metrics. Consumer lag was coincident (likely unrelated) but exacerbated observability because logs feeding derived metrics were delayed.

anna-oncall: marking incident as acknowledged on PagerDuty.

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged by anna-oncall at 2026-03-09T18:12:03Z.

jenna-observability: customer note: Support ticket #6789 created and updated - CV: internal dashboards stale for ~14m, no external API impact.

mike-sre: mitigation validated. Steps to lower blast radius: revert scrape timeout after stabilization? Also need long-term fixes.

anna-oncall: will leave timeout at 20s for 1 hour to let backlog clear, then revert. I'll also create a cgroup/ulimit ticket for platform to track ephemeral port/socket tuning.

kai-platform: follow-ups: 1) add horizontal autoscale for metricproxy based on cpu and outgoing connection queue, 2) add alert for ephemeral_port_exhaustion (netstat sparsity), 3) add auto-restart policy for metricproxy when connection errors spike > X/min, 4) revisit kafka consumer autoscaling for logs-ingest-main.

mike-sre: also propose runbook entry: when SRE-PROM-SCRAPE-TIMEOUT fires: check metricproxy CPU, check open file/socket counts, scale metricproxy, increase scrape timeout, restart sequentially, check kafka consumer lag. Add runbook steps and commands.

anna-oncall: creating incident ticket in JIRA: RED-INC-2026-103. I'll include timeline, commands run, logs, and links to dashboards.

[~50m later]

anna-oncall: last check - all panels stable, consumer lag back to normal. closing PagerDuty incident.

pagerduty-bot: incident resolved by anna-oncall at 2026-03-09T19:01:18Z.

mike-sre: nice work. Postmortem owners: mike-sre (technical RCA), jenna-observability (observability gaps), kai-platform (platform tuning). Assigning action items in the JIRA ticket.

jenna-observability: immediate tasks: update Prom scrape default timeout to 15s for flaky infra targets and add dashboard annotations for any future sweeps.

kai-platform: I'll file a platform task to tune ephemeral ports and make autoscaling baseline more aggressive for metricproxy.

anna-oncall: short post-incident note sent to #incidents-summary with TL;DR and runbook link. Will follow up with a short blameless RCA doc.

mike-sre: closing thread here. good collaboration. :thumbsup:
